name: MAT309H1 — Deductive Derivation (Gödel's Completeness Theorem)
description: Completeness (1930): Γ ⊢ φ ⟺ Γ ⊨ φ. φ provable from Γ iff φ true in every model of Γ. SOUNDNESS (⊢→⊨) easy. COMPLETENESS (⊨→⊢) is deep.

steps.template_en: Completeness (1930): Γ ⊢ φ ⟺ Γ ⊨ φ. φ provable from Γ iff φ true in every model of Γ. SOUNDNESS (⊢→⊨) easy. COMPLETENESS (⊨→⊢) is deep.
steps.template_zh: 完备定理(1930)：Γ⊢φ⟺Γ⊨φ。φ从Γ可证当且仅当φ在Γ的每个模型真。可靠性容易。完备性深刻。

steps.template_en: Proof: suppose Γ⊭φ (no proof). Build maximal consistent set extending Γ∪{¬φ} (Zorn's Lemma). Henkin's method: add witness constants.
steps.template_zh: 证明：假设Γ⊭φ。构造极大一致集扩张Γ∪{¬φ}(Zorn引理)。Henkin方法：添加见证常元。

steps.template_en: From maximal consistent Δ, build TERM MODEL: domain = equivalence classes of terms. P([t₁],...,[tₙ]) holds iff P(t₁,...,tₙ)∈Δ. This model satisfies exactly the formulas in Δ. So Γ∪{¬φ} has a model → Γ⊭φ.
steps.template_zh: 从极大一致Δ构造项模型：论域=项的等价类。P成立当且仅当P在Δ中。该模型恰好满足Δ中公式。所以Γ∪{¬φ}有模型→Γ⊭φ。

steps.template_en: COMPACTNESS: if every finite subset of Σ has a model, then Σ has a model. Why: if Σ has no model, Σ⊢⊥, but proofs finite → finite subset also ⊢⊥ → no model.
steps.template_zh: 紧致性：若Σ的每个有限子集有模型，则Σ有模型。若Σ无模型则Σ⊢⊥，但证明有限→有限子集也⊢⊥→无模型。

steps.template_en: Completeness is the FOUNDATION of model theory. Syntactic proof systems CAPTURE semantic consequence. Applications: (1) Compactness → nonstandard models. (2) Löwenheim-Skolem. (3) Herbrand's theorem → automated theorem proving.
steps.template_zh: 完备定理是模型论的基础。语法证明系统捕获语义推论。应用：(1)紧致性→非标准模型。(2)Löwenheim-Skolem。(3)Herbrand定理→自动定理证明。

steps.template_en: First-order logic is 'just right' — not too strong (incompleteness) and not too weak (complete but expressive). The boundary between completeness and incompleteness is the boundary of first-order logic itself.
steps.template_zh: 一阶逻辑'恰到好处'——不太强(不完备性)不太弱(完备但有表达力)。完备与不完备的边界就是一阶逻辑本身的边界。
